title: RYOT® 305mm SmellSafe™ Pro-Duffle
description:
RYOT
®
305mm SmellSafe™ Pro-Duffle
The all new and improved RYOT
®
Pro-Duffle’s padded wall design will fit your glass like a glove.  Secure and arrange your accessories using the removable interchangeable Velcro Padding. The Durable modest exterior features a long pocket, and weather proof cotton canvas fabric. Patents Pending.
RYOT
®
SmellSafe™
– is an activated carbon absorption technology where microscopic charcoal particles are fused together to create an odor protective barrier, blocking unwanted odors from escaping. Combined with our SmellSafe™ moisture seal zipper, RYOT® Pack and Protect™ has you ready to roll!
FEATURES:
Dimensions: 305mm L x 228mm W x 216mm H
Smell Safe
™
Carbon application
Weather resistant
Antimicrobial microfiber 38mm padded wall design holds tubes and accessories securely in place
Dual cinch straps for added security
Removable 241mm long foam pocketed pad
2 removable 101mm foam pads
Removable, round 152mm foam pad
Padded Shoulder strap
Lockable zipper for added security option (Lock not included)
Designed to Pack and Protect by RYOT
®
